tickerText: [TENNIS] Championship Sunday at the indoor ATP 500s: Carlos Alcaraz meets Alex de Minaur for the Erste Bank Open crown in Vienna while Jiri Lehečka and Valentin Vacherot contest the Swiss Indoors Basel final • [SQUASH] PSA platinum season shifts to Philadelphia as the U.S. Open Squash Championships begin while Brno's Czech Open and Coffs Harbour's North Coast Open close their weekend draws • [BADMINTON] HYLO Open finals day in Saarbrücken: Lakshya Sen faces Jonatan Christie and P. V. Sindhu meets Line Kjærsfeldt in the singles title matches with doubles and mixed finals to follow • [PICKLEBALL] Inaugural MLP Nations Cup crowns its first champion at Brookhaven with Sunday semifinals and finals on Championship Court before the Opendoor PPA World Championships main draw opens Monday • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier semifinal Sunday at Sud de France Arena: Sun Yingsha vs Wang Yidi and Kuai Man vs Chen Yi in all-Chinese women's semis while Hugo Calderano, Truls Möregårdh and Patrick Franziska chase the men's final

newsItems.title: Nations Cup Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts Nations Cup semis and finals to crown the first MLP international champion before PPA Worlds qualifying begins Monday in Farmers Branch.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: Sun Yingsha–Wang Yidi and Kuai Man–Chen Yi headline women's semis as Calderano, Möregårdh and Franziska battle for men's final spots at WTT Champions.

newsItems.title: Vienna & Basel Finals
newsItems.excerpt: Alcaraz–de Minaur decides Vienna's Erste Bank Open while Lehečka–Vacherot contest the Swiss Indoors Basel title on ATP 500 championship Sunday.

newsItems.title: Hylo Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Sen–Christie and Sindhu–Kjærsfeldt lead five HYLO Open title matches in Saarbrücken after both Indians reached Super 500 finals without dropping a game.
